final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  post out.len() == 2 + keys.len() - (if keys.contains("mode") then 1 else 0) - (if keys.contains("level") then 1 else 0)
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["x", "mode"], ["1", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "1"]
  ex settings(["x", "x"], ["1", "2"]) == ["fast", "3", "2"]
  -- Note: the second post line counts duplicate keys twice, so it disagrees
  -- with the last ex line. The body follows the task and the ex lines.
  var ks: List[str] = ["mode", "level"]
  var vs: List[str] = ["fast", "3"]
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    var found = False
    for j in range(0, ks.len())
      if ks[j] == k
        vs[j] = copy values[i]
        found = True
    if found == False
      ks.append(copy k)
      vs.append(copy values[i])
  vs
